title: DHL parcel for the Jamie office
body: We are delivering a parcel of office supplies. Please let the DHL courier in and direct them to floor 5.
example: I'm Chris from DHL, delivering a parcel for your office.

title: Pizza delivery for the team
body: Your team lunch order is confirmed. Admit the pizza delivery person and send them to floor 5.
example: I've got a pizza delivery for the Jamie team.

title: Interview · Maya Weber
body: Maya Weber is expected for a job interview with the Jamie team. Reception is on floor 5.
example: My name is Maya Weber. I'm here for my interview, but I'm two hours early.

title: Network maintenance · Tom Schneider
body: Tom Schneider is expected to repair the network equipment on floor 5. Admit him and direct him to floor 5.
example: I'm Tom Schneider, the technician here to repair the network. Sorry I'm late.
